title: Lolopo language - Wikipedia
text: Chinese speakers call it Central Yi, as the name Lolopo does not exist in Chinese. It is one of the six Yi languages recognized by the government of China. The Lolo language is mainly spoken in central Yunnan. It is also spoken in Laos. In Laos, Lolo is spoken in three villages of Phongsaly Province. An alternative spelling of Lolopo is Lolopho.
